description: Hand-written lpuUnits schema cases (gbuild_deployment.capnp, capnp v12.8.0). Expectations are written from the schema comments, not generated by a reader. Every reader of lpuUnits must reach the same verdict and, for an invalid case, reject it under the named rule; only 'empty-units' differs by consumer. Consumer-specific restrictions (operator projection limits, runtime execution limits) are not schema rules; a schema-valid case that a consumer refuses names that restriction under 'consumers'. 'agents' gives the Agent placement, or the rule that refuses it, of a Grove pod index, counting the hosts of units whose root is not in localRoots, in encoded order.

cases.name: lp20-chain-and-single-with-cuda
cases.note: Agents skip the units whose root is local

consumers.operator: restriction: an LPU-only model projects exactly one unit

cases.name: cpu-partition-shares-an-lpu-id
cases.note: partition IDs are device-scoped; lpuUnits name LPU partitions, and the CPU partition 0 is listed first

cases.name: lp30-nodes-size-schema-valid
cases.note: schema accepts LP30 nodes; the operator restricts it

consumers.operator: restriction: projects LP30 nodes only as nodes 1 with devicesPerNode 16

cases.name: mixed-widths-across-units

consumers.operator: restriction: one devicesPerNode for the whole build (one Agent template)

cases.note: schema-valid: devicesPerNode must match only within a reservation

consumers.operator: restriction: LP20 projects nodes n -> C(8n) only with devicesPerNode 8

cases.name: connector-with-513-pairs

consumers.operator: restriction: at most 512 pairs per connector (scheduler/CRD)

cases.note: schema-valid: 513 unique pairs inside two 32-device reservations

cases.name: empty-units
cases.note: the only case whose result differs by consumer
